_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Falling leg still inside the 24-31 Panic band; ±2 score moves occur in only 3% of 12h windows so the honest call is hold the rung until a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit Panic/HOLD; narrative supplies bearish crowding evidence but no forward phase — both align RISK_OFF
next_move.confirmed_if: Next 12h phase score stays within ±2 and fear holds 24-31 while BTC fails to reclaim $80k
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC reclaims $81.5k with CVD lifting off 0 (short killed, Denial), or fear breaks under 24 with funding turning negative (rung slips to Capitulation)
